messages:
mira: Quick experiment proposal: 30-min quickstart workshop + 72h credit drip. Objective: increase signup->first-success within 24h. Split creatives into 'Outcome-first' vs 'Use-case-first' and route signups into two onboarding flows with different prompt packs. Thoughts?
jamal: 👍 metrics to track: signup->first_prompt_time, first-24h activation rate, %using prompt templates. Can analytics add a tiny dashboard?
olivia: Copy angles: Outcome-first: 'Ship reliable LLM features with predictable latency & cost.' Use-case-first: 'Customer support + docs search playbook.' CTAs: 'Claim credits' vs 'Reserve a seat'.
sam_sales: For PLG, credits CTA wins. Routing: utm_campaign=quickstartA|quickstartB -> auto-cohort. SDR rule: company email + tokens>800 in 7d => hot lead. SLA: first contact <=4h.
ops-bot: Routing rule created. Example API call: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","utm":"quickstartA"}'
``` -> sets user.cohort=quickstartA and posts to #sales-inbound. :white_check_mark:
mira: Assets needed: 1) two LinkedIn micro-posts, 2) landing A/B, 3) 3-template prompt pack per funnel, 4) analytics dashboard, 5) SDR playbook. Timeline: drafts by EOD day after tomorrow; routing live Mon; workshop Wed 11am PT.
jamal: I'll spin up a Grafana panel with cohort filters and events: signup, first_prompt_run, credit_grant. Putting a mock in /drive/marketing/quickstart-1967002468/grafana-mock.png
olivia: Drafts below:
Post A (Outcome): 'Cut inference cost, keep latency predictable. Join our 30-min quickstart + get starter credits.'
Post B (Use-case): 'See how support teams ship LLM automations. Live quickstart + prompt pack + credits.'
Landing blurb: 'Quickstart workshop T: demo, rapid prompts, 72h credits to try in your stack.'
sam_sales: SDR script for hot leads: "Congrats on claiming credits — saw your quickstart signup. Want a 15-min setup call to connect to your infra?" Include token threshold and company name.
nora: Prompt packs I'll build: quickstart_outcome.md and quickstart_usecase.md each with 3 templates: assistant (instruction), retrieval-snippet, email-generator. Will add examples and a small 'how to run' section. Place in /docs/prompt-templates/quickstart-1967002468.md
jamal: Analytics events to emit: 
- 'credit_grant' {cohort, amount}
- 'prompt_pack_download' {cohort}
- 'first_prompt_run' {cohort, template_id}
Include cohort prop on all events so attribution is clean.
ops-bot: Tracking code snippet: ```html
<script>track('first_prompt_run',{cohort:'quickstartA',template:'assistant_v1'});</script>
``` Add to onboarding flow after template runner.
mira: Also try a follow-up nudge: send 24h email with one small 'activation challenge' (run this prompt, paste output) and 48h reminder if no run. That should nudge activation.
olivia: Email copy (24h): 'Two-minute challenge: run this prompt to see immediate value.' Include single-click run button tied to cohort.
sam_sales: For routing: add a field 'use_case' on signup so SDRs can tailor outreach. Also queue any user with company domain and >2k tokens in 7d as 'enterprise-warm'.
ops-bot: Webhook to #sales-inbound configured. Example payload: ```json
{"email":"{{email}}","cohort":"quickstartA","use_case":"support","tokens_7d":1200}
```
mira: Final checklist: olivia finalize posts; nora finish prompt packs; jamal dashboard live; ops confirm routing + webhooks; sam prepare SDR messages. We'll reconvene in this thread for final review. :rocket:
